documentation: The MoveNet MultiPose Lightning model the camera and local apps run, pinned file by file. `pnpm run fetch:pose-model` downloads it from TF Hub into models/<id>/ and checks every file against the SHA-256 here; the model is not committed, the same way the extension bundles are not. A build with TWRMC_POSE_MODEL=local or embedded reads it from there. See docs/pose-stream.md.
